meta.title: A failed store is reported as a failure here (unlike the event upload)

direct.expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 902, message 'Upload failed' — upload_file_to_s3 returns nil and this endpoint (unlike /trade/upload_file) checks it. Nothing is stored. Note: code 902 is reused here with a custom message; its catalogue text is 'Only active or paused jobs can be cancelled'.
